svg.title: The item
svg.desc: A white robotaxi seen from the front left, with the elements of the item drawn inside it at illustrative positions: the Autoware computer, the safety monitor, Autoware's roof sensor and the monitor's own sensors at the front. A list gives each element inside the item and outside it, with its rating from WP-C-04. The positions are not decided; everything is a draft for engineering review.

g.text: The item: what the safety case is about
The sensors, the Autoware computer and the safety monitor are the item; the vehicle they drive is not (WP-C-01).
OUTSIDE THE ITEM, BOUND BY AN ASSUMPTION
Ratings derived in WP-C-04 §4; DQ-018 A: the monitor has its own sensors.
ILLUSTRATION · positions are not decided; the hardware is chosen with the vehicle · draft
